en.topic_title: Greenpeace urges HK gov’t to cut Po Pin Chau visitor quota after Nat. Day overcrowding
en.topic_summary:
Environmental NGO Greenpeace has urged the government to review its ecotourism policies and reduce visitor quotas for a popular Sai Kung trail after finding overcrowding and damage on the first day of the Golden Week holiday.



Tourists stand on the Po Pin Chau viewing platform on October 1, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



The green group said in a statement that Sai Kung’s Po Pin Chau trail saw overcrowding on Thursday, which marked China’s National Day and the beginning of a weekl
